 Sandro Mamukelashvili drops 23 points Monday 
 by Ari Koslow | Lakers Correspondent | Tue, Nov 10th 2026, 12:33am EST 
 Sandro Mamukelashvili scored 23 points (7-13 FG, 5-8 3PT, 4-4 FT) to go along with eight rebounds, three assists, one steal and one block in the Lakers 124-114 win over the Hawks. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Mamukelashvili played 32 minutes despite coming off the bench and took full advantage of the opportunity. He recorded season-highs in both points scored and minutes played. It is unclear if he'll see the same run when Austin Reaves is healthy.
